thread:
anna: Heads-up: vendor pen-test intake arrived. They need RBAC rules, KMS access pattern, and an evidence export run during the test. Proposing a dry-run tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PT in staging.

kevin: I can own RBAC. Plan: three ephemeral roles - pt-assessor-read, pt-assessor-upload, pt-assessor-netdiag. TTL 8h, auto-revoke hook 30m after window. Will post IAM snippets.

mira: For KMS: dedicated key alias/pt-evidence with GenerateDataKey for envelope encryption. Signing should be via a constrained signing proxy, not direct assessor keys. Will draft policy.

sec-bot: Previous assessment flagged broad S3 prefixes (SI-712). Enforce bucket policy to only allow PutObject to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-upload` and prefix `evidence/vendor-522/*`.

ops-oncall: I will provision S3 prefix and lifecycle (12 months), enable server access logs replication to audit bucket, and expose presign endpoint that requires envelope headers. Need IAM JSON + KMS ARN.

kevin: Draft IAM snippet posted in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1599. Example allow: s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging/evidence/vendor-522/* with condition limiting source role. Revoke hook added.

mira: KMS ARN draft: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ccddeeff-0011-2233-4455-66778899aabb. Key policy allows ops-signing-proxy kms:Sign,kms:GenerateDataKey; assessors have no Decrypt. Rotation disabled for window.

triage-bot: Suggest creating GH issue template `pt-remediation` and add webhook to post P0/P1 to #incidents automatically.

anna: Action items: @kevin land RBAC PR (EOD), @mira finalize KMS policy (EOD), @ops-oncall create prefix + presign flow (this morning), @triage-bot wire GH template. Dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT in #release-war-room.

ops-oncall: S3 prefix ready: s3://pt-evidence-staging/evidence/vendor-522/. Presign endpoint https://upload.redwood.company/vendors/522 accepted a smoke upload. Server logs replicating to s3://pt-evidence-audit/.

kevin: Roles created in staging and smoke-tested. Revoke hook tested. PR updated with assume-role commands.

mira: KMS policy attached and tested with envelope flow. Signing proxy demo successful. Will add docs for assessors.

anna: Good. During the external window, severe findings go into the remediation tracker; do not remediate live unless incident declares a live-fix. Retest window tentatively 2 weeks after fixes. Closing unless blockers appear.
